meta_title: Kurnia Dewi Budicantika — Physicochemical QC Analyst
meta_description: Physicochemical QC analyst with 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry — HPLC, GC, AAS, FTIR, ICP-OES, UV-Vis — working to GMP, GLP, and ISO 17025 standards.
hero_summary: {#b}3+ years{/b} testing everything from raw materials to finished products in the pharmaceutical industry — {#b}HPLC, GC, AAS, FTIR, ICP-OES, UV-Vis{/b} — to {#b}GMP, GLP, and ISO 17025{/b} standards.
hero_portrait_alt: Kurnia Dewi Budicantika standing in front of Sechenov University, Moscow
about_body: Physicochemical QC analyst with {#b}3+ years of experience{/b} in the pharmaceutical industry (Kalbe Consumer Health, Kalbe Group), skilled in testing raw materials, intermediates, and finished products using HPLC, GC, AAS, FTIR, ICP-OES, UV-Vis spectrophotometry, and a TLC UV scanner to {#b}GMP, GLP, and ISO 17025{/b} standards. Experienced in leading a continuous improvement team (Quality Control Circle) that cut {#b}analysis lead time by 67%{/b} and delivered cost savings of {#b}IDR 59.6 million per year{/b}. Currently completing a {#b}Bachelor of Pharmacy at Binawan University{/b} (graduating December 2026).
experience_kch_analysis: Performed {#b}physicochemical analysis of raw materials, intermediates, and finished products{/b} using {#b}HPLC, UV-Vis spectrophotometry, FTIR, TLC, and ICP-OES{/b} in line with GMP and ISO 17025.
experience_kch_oot_oos: Investigated {#b}Out of Trend (OOT) and Out of Specification (OOS){/b} results that deviated from normal trends or specifications, and documented findings in OOT/OOS reports following GMP procedures.
experience_kch_qcc: Led the Finished Goods team as {#b}Quality Control Circle (QCC) leader{/b} of a 10-person team (October 2024 – August 2025); designed and standardized solution-stability studies for reference solutions and mobile phases that cut pre-testing analysis lead time for bulk samples {#b}by 67%{/b} (beating the 60% target) and raised {#b}bulk release output capacity by 50% per day{/b}.
experience_kch_savings: Delivered {#b}analysis cost savings of IDR 59.6 million per year{/b} and {#b}prevented production line stops{/b} in primary packaging for three priority products (Mixagrip Flu Caplets, Mixagrip Flu & Cough, Mextril Tablets), with impact confirmed through cross-functional interviews with the {#b}Production, PPIC, and QA teams{/b}.
experience_kch_method_transfer: Carried out {#b}analytical method validation transfers{/b} with the {#b}R&D team{/b} to make sure methods were ready before use in routine testing.
experience_kch_troubleshooting: Handled {#b}laboratory instrument troubleshooting{/b}, including internal vendor training on {#b}HPLC Waters Alliance{/b} and ICP-OES.
experience_kch_dissolution: Performed routine {#b}dissolution apparatus calibration{/b} (performance verification test with USP standard tablets) to pharmacopoeia, GMP, and GLP standards.
experience_kch_stock_opname: Ran {#b}chemical reagent stock takes{/b} and ensured compliance with {#b}safety procedures{/b} for chemical storage and handling.
experience_kch_suggestion_system: Proposed process improvements through the {#b}Suggestion System (SS){/b} to raise the QC team's efficiency and work quality.
experience_intern_analysis: Assisted with {#b}physicochemical parameter analysis{/b} (pH, water content, loss on drying, disintegration time, dissolution, assay) using both {#b}conventional (volumetric){/b} and {#b}instrumental (HPLC, TLC, spectrophotometry){/b} methods.
experience_intern_reagents: Prepared {#b}reagents and standard solutions{/b} for laboratory testing.
experience_intern_stock_opname: Ran {#b}chemical reagent stock takes{/b} in the QC laboratory.
education_bachelor_status: All coursework completed ({#b}certificate of completion issued{/b}); graduation scheduled for {#b}December 2026{/b}.
education_thesis_title: “Comparison of Maceration and Ultrasonic-Assisted Extraction (UAE) on the Antioxidant Activity of Red Pelawan Leaf Extract (Tristaniopsis merguensis Griff.)”.
education_vocational_certificate: {#b}LSP-P1 SMAKBO Competency Certificate{/b}: gravimetry, volumetry, proximate analysis, UV-Vis spectrophotometry, AAS, microbiology, and electrochemistry (2018–2021).
education_international_sechenov: {#b}Summer School Program, Sechenov University, Russia{/b} — Innovative Drugs.
education_international_cpu: {#b}Summer International School Program, China Pharmaceutical University{/b} (2023) — research on herbal medicines and Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM).
awards_qcc_title: Top 10 — QCC Convention, Kalbe Consumer Health (2025)
awards_qcc_body: {#b}Project team leader{/b} for “Reducing Pre-Testing Time for Bulk Drug Product Samples by 60%”.
awards_training_hplc: {#b}HPLC Waters Alliance system troubleshooting{/b}, Kalbe Consumer Health.
awards_training_certificate: {#b}LSP-P1 SMAKBO Competency Certificate{/b} (gravimetry, volumetry, proximate analysis, UV-Vis spectrophotometry, AAS, microbiology, electrochemistry).
awards_publication_journal: {#b}Helium: Journal of Science and Applied Chemistry{/b}, Vol. 1, No. 2 (2021), Pakuan University, Bogor.
